hook.name: FeeHookV2
hook.description: Skims a configurable ETH-side fee (default 1%, max 2%) from every swap on an ETH/WORD pool, routing collected ETH 25% to a RewardsDistributor, 25% to a BountyEngine, and 50% to a WordStaking contract via a hardcoded, non-adjustable split. Swaps are gated until the owner calls enableTrading(); a per-buy WORD output cap is enforced for one hour after launch.
